note: Eight complete official brochure drawings and 138 unit-specific sheets from the Homeland broker mirror. The brochure includes historical non-pool and 2 BR duplex variants beyond the current four-category FAQ. Only pages 63 and 65 visibly print brochure NET areas. Other brochure areas remain unavailable. Unit areas retain the mirror’s printed NET AREA definition, subject to approved contractual confirmation. Units 203, 206, 504, 702 and 1110 have conflicting written floor labels versus their key plans. Options use unit numbers without endorsing a floor. The mirror visibly prints 1,355.5 for unit 105 and 656.6 for unit 107, while Tanami lists 1,355.05 and 656.06 respectively. These conflicts require developer confirmation. All original sheets and watermarks remain intact.
